Title: Routing Engine Design
Content: RoutingService routes by TaskType, node role (NodeRole: Fast/Deep/Hybrid/Standby), VRAM availability, queue depth, and health. Hard rules: Autocomplete always routes to Fast nodes; queues >2 pending trigger fallback. Role-based scoring with configurable weights. NodeRegistry hot-reloadable via IOptionsMonitor<NodeTopologyConfig> with atomic Interlocked.Exchange rebuild. Fallback chains per node, stored in routing.json. RoutingService primary constructor: (INodeRegistry, Func<string,IInferenceQueue>, ILogger, INodeHealthCache?, IOptions<RoutingOptions>?).
